transcript: My name is Passendufernando. I am an entry-level IT professional preparing for a data analyst role. I practiced Python, SQL, and Power BI. I worked on a sales dashboard for business. My part was sales report. The issue was missing data. The system made reporting easier. I want to improve my skills.
feedback: You did a good job explaining your experience with a sales dashboard project. However, your answer could be more structured and clear. Try to focus on the specific problem you solved and how you used your skills to achieve it.

Ability to work on a sales dashboard project

better_answer_example: I worked on a sales dashboard project where I was responsible for creating a sales report. The challenge was that the system was missing some data, which made it difficult to generate accurate reports. I used my skills in Python and SQL to extract the missing data and then created a report using Power BI. This improved the reporting process and made it easier for the business to make informed decisions.
